s1.syndrome_frame: Acute inflammatory arthritis following intra-articular injection
salient_findings: Acute bilateral knee swelling and pain
Elevated peripheral white blood cell count and inflammatory markers
key_facts: 61-year-old African American woman
Bilateral knee osteoarthritis
Third weekly Synvisc viscosupplementation injections in each knee
Onset of pain 12 hours after injections
No fever, chills, or malaise
Right knee: suprapatellar effusion, range of motion 0-70°, no erythema, no pain with micromotion
Left knee: moderate suprapatellar effusion, range of motion 0-30°, no erythema, pain with micromotion
Peripheral white blood cell count of 12.8×10^3/mm³
C-reactive protein level of 159 mg/L
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 79 mm/hr
Bilateral knee arthrocentesis with elevated synovial fluid WBC count
Negative gram stain and cultures in both knees

differentials: Infectious arthritis due to atypical bacteria
per_call: Infectious arthritis due to atypical bacteria

shortlist.label: Septic arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated synovial fluid WBC count and acute onset of pain and swelling

shortlist.label: Viscosupplementation-related inflammatory reaction
shortlist.why_kept: Recent intra-articular injection of Synvisc and onset of symptoms 12 hours later

shortlist.label: Crystal-induced arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated synovial fluid WBC count and absence of fever or systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Pseudogout
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated synovial fluid WBC count and absence of fever or systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Gout
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated synovial fluid WBC count and acute onset of pain and swelling

raw.rationale: The patient presented with acute bilateral knee swelling and pain after receiving Synvisc viscosupplementation injections, with onset of pain 12 hours after the injections and no signs of infection such as fever, chills, or malaise, and negative gram stain and cultures.

rejected.label: Septic arthritis
rejected.why: Negative gram stain and cultures in both knees make infection unlikely

rejected.label: Crystal-induced arthritis
rejected.why: No evidence of crystal formation or deposition in the synovial fluid

rejected.label: Pseudogout
rejected.why: No evidence of calcium pyrophosphate dihydrate crystals in the synovial fluid

rejected.label: Gout
rejected.why: No evidence of monosodium urate crystals in the synovial fluid
